title: Thailand, Covered.
note: Print palette, sampled from the shipped 2026 edition so the rebuilt book stays the same object on the shelf and beside the cover already published on the site. Paper #F7F1E4 and chrome #2B1E28 were measured off pages 1 and 8 of thailand-covered.pdf, not lifted from globals.css. The site's magenta #D81264 survives verbatim because it IS the brand and it holds on this paper; the site's lime, teal and saffron do not enter the book — a paid object carries one accent, and the site's five are a screen palette. `ink` is darkened from the site's #17120F toward the aubergine family so body text belongs to the same book as the chrome.
audience: American first-timers, 7-14 nights, arriving with the islands already imagined as interchangeable

contrast_measured._note: Measured on paper #F7F1E4, not eyeballed. Each token's JOB follows from its ratio — this is what stops accent being used for 11px labels.
contrast_measured.accent on paper: 4.45:1 — BELOW AA for small text. Rules, large type and fills ONLY.
contrast_measured.accent_deep on paper: 7.29:1 — the accent for anything small: eyebrows, keys, labels
contrast_measured.accent on chrome: 3.18:1 — cover display type only, never a cover label
